release_notes:
Official v1.0.0 Release - Decoded Logger unblocking for RX/TX mixed configs, raw TX packet logging, and automated unit tests validation.

New Features:
  - Decoded Logger Unblocking: Dynamically filters out transmit-only frames from the required cycle list, preventing log blockage when both RX and TX frames are configured.
  - Transmitted Packet Logging: Hooked into raw wire recording to decode and log TX packets on the fly, ensuring all signals are correctly represented in the decoded Excel log.
  - Automated Test Suite: Added new unit tests for TX-only logging verifying cycle integrity and correctness.
